scene_lunar_comms.title: Deep Space Telemetry Lab, Hyderabad
scene_lunar_comms.dialogue: Radio static bursts through the headphones: 'Tara... if you're hearing this on Sunday, Solar Tower 4 breached its coolant line nineteen hours ago. Or rather... nineteen hours from now. Stop the ignition protocol before 08:00.'
suggested_actions: Verify the quantum frequency with Tara
Upload the emergency coolant patch to the lunar array
Ask Rao how he opened the time channel

verify_telemetry.response_dialogue: Tara locks onto the signal carrier: 'The chronometric signature is genuine. The packet is coming from tomorrow morning.'

scene_quantum_override.title: The Quantum Transmission Console
scene_quantum_override.dialogue: Tara has her hand hovered over the transmitter: 'We have one burst transmission window. If we transmit the shutdown code, we alter the future. If the code causes the failure, we lock ourselves in a paradox. What do you order?'
suggested_actions: Transmit the direct shutdown command immediately
Transmit the exact voice note back to warn Rao
